compiled_state.title: agents gov-copy-writer/doc-writer/ui-designer: dispatched under isolation but missing Session HEAD Sync section
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker (discovered during b8c8-8566 anti-pattern scan)

#### Expected Behavior
Per bug a951-d6f2-0c21-443f, every named dso:* agent dispatched under isolation:"worktree" should include a '## Startup: Session HEAD Sync' section so it syncs its isolated worktree to SESSION_HEAD before reading source files. The structural test tests/agents/test-agents-have-session-head-sync.sh enforces this for 13 agents.

#### Actual Behavior
gov-copy-writer.md, doc-writer.md, and ui-designer.md write harvestable artifacts and are dispatched under sprint Phase E worktree isolation, yet have NO '## Startup: Session HEAD Sync' section and are NOT in the test's TARGET_AGENTS list. Under isolation they would branch from origin/main rather than SESSION_HEAD, potentially missing prior session work. OPEN QUESTION: verify whether these are reliably isolation-dispatched (if so, this is a real sync gap and they should be added to both the agents and the session-head-sync test TARGET_AGENTS); the exclusion may be an oversight in the a951 rollout. Investigate before fixing.

comments.body: Resolving as continuation of b8c8-8566 ADVANCED investigation (root cause already established: these 3 file-writing agents are dispatched under sprint Phase E universal worktree isolation but lack the canonical '## Startup: Session HEAD Sync' section). Fix: add the canonical section (guarded, no-op when SESSION_BRANCH/HEAD unset → safe for non-isolated dispatch paths too) to all 3, and add them to test-agents-have-session-head-sync.sh TARGET_AGENTS. TDD: RED (extend TARGET → 3 FAIL) → GREEN.
